title: Document admission trace blind spots and unscoped latency
outcome: Admission timing documentation explicitly describes when a terminal trace or mutex span is absent and which durability latency remains outside scoped phase totals, so missing output or a remainder is not misread as proof of no wait.
acceptance: The admission timing documentation states that a never-returning admission emits no terminal trace and a failed try_lock_now acquisition emits no mutex span.
The documentation states that persistence and durability fence time remains included in totalUs but may appear as unscoped remainder rather than its own phase.
